comment: Ordered rebrand rules applied by rebrand.mjs to every tracked text file of a pristine DataDog/dd-sdk-reactnative tree (base: UPSTREAM_BASE = 3.5.3). Order matters: more specific rules must precede rules that match a substring of them. 'literal' rules are plain string replacement; 'regex' rules are applied with the 'g' flag and may reference capture groups in 'to' ($1). JS and native (Kotlin/Swift/ObjC) files are rebranded together so the native-module bridge names stay consistent (e.g. NativeModules.DdRum <-> @ReactModule(name="DdRum") both become Oo). Fork-owned identity files (LICENSE, NOTICE, README, .github, patches, scripts/openobserve, example) are handled by the keep-ours overlay, not here. IMPORTANT: native artifact COORDINATES (com.datadoghq:*, Datadog* pods) are NOT in 'rules' — see 'deferredRules' below; renaming them before the OpenObserve native forks are published breaks the build.

rules.why: expo config plugin package name (must precede the generic 'datadog' rules)
npm scope for every workspace package (@datadog/mobile-react-native, -react-navigation, -react-native-session-replay, etc.) in one uniform rule

all camelCase Dd-prefixed identifiers -> Oo: classes, native module names, view manager names (DdRum->OoRum, DdSdkReactNative->OoSdkReactNative, DdPrivacyView->OoPrivacyView). Word-boundary guarded so it never matches mid-identifier (e.g. myDdRum). Applied to JS + native together to keep the bridge consistent.
RUM/telemetry event internal namespace field renamed _dd -> _oo (matches the rum-events-format schema fork).

deferredRules.comment: DO NOT MOVE INTO 'rules' UNTIL the OpenObserve iOS + Android native forks (Workstream B/C, tracker A5) are published to CocoaPods/Maven. rebrand.mjs ignores this key. Applying these renames the native artifact COORDINATES the fork depends on; until the forks exist on the registries, `pod install` and Gradle dependency resolution would fail. During Phase 0 the build resolves the ORIGINAL upstream coordinates (local-only, never shipped). Switch these on in task A5.

rules.why: iOS native core CocoaPods/SPM product names

items: ddsource / ddtags query params and tags — wire protocol to the intake; handled by the backend (doc 02), not renamed client-side to avoid breaking ingest.
DD-API-KEY header — auth rename to oo-api-key is coupled to the doc 02 header-auth backend change (design §6); the native core emits it, so it is a native-fork concern, not a JS rename.
Cosmetic 'Datadog' mentions in prose/comments/links to docs.datadoghq.com — not identity-critical; handled in a later docs pass.
